policy: The leaf is never cropped. The located rectangle is used to aim the station's viewpoint, and to pop the cut forward off its own page only when the find passes all three tests (confidence, ink ratio, row variation). Otherwise the leaf stands flat and nothing is claimed. Measured on 24 hand-checked leaves: 10 of 12 true cuts pop, 1 false pop.
